plan.summary: BRO-5333: Sounds and Stage's review of The Comedy About Spies (publishDate 2025-05-13, the 2025 Noel Coward run that opened 2025-05-06) was re-collected from Show Score onto the 2026 entry on 2026-10-14 at a new soundsandstage.com URL, so the URL-ownership check did not recognise the copy BRO-4339 moved to 2025 on 2026-10-12 (that copy, soundsandstage--tim-todd.json, is invalid + wrongProduction). The class-A contamination gate fails main on it. Move the complete 2026 copy to the 2025 entry, where it becomes that run's only usable Sounds and Stage review.

actions.description: Review published 2025-05-13 is of the 2025 production (opened 2025-05-06); the 2026 entry opened ~450 days later.
